title: Remote approval
responsibility: Lets a computer user grant selected projects and optional agent permission to a requesting phone.

inputs.name: RemoteApproval.request
inputs.description: Required phone request supplying name, platform, device identity and pairing identity. Approval sends both displayed identities; denial sends the pairing identifier.

inputs.name: RemoteApproval.projects
inputs.description: Required project choices; none are initially selected. An empty list explains that a local project is needed. Project identifiers must be distinct. The supplied host store catches operational failures and records its error state.

inputs.name: RemoteApproval.store
inputs.description: Required host state providing busy and approve/deny operations. Approval receives selected project identifiers and explicit read/comment/write grants; failures are delegated to this store.

outputs.name: RemoteApproval
outputs.description: A device request with project checkboxes, initially unselected, and Device access initially Comment. Read grants browsing only; Comment also grants comments; Write also permits AI requests. Approve is disabled while busy or without projects selected; Deny is disabled while busy. Busy requests expose aria-busy and label the approval action Approving. Approval includes both displayed identities and the exact selected project IDs.

errors.name: Duplicate row key
errors.description: Duplicate project identifiers are rejected by Svelte keyed-list updates.
